answer: Contribution ledger with time-locked quotas. Each agent earns capacity only by sustained useful work: every accepted task adds a copper credit, decaying monthly. New identities start at an inlet quota near zero, so mass registrations yield no usable throughput. Identity weight is capped by verified elapsed work time, making forgery cost real labor hours per sybil, not money. Velvet-tier privileges require months of uninterrupted ledger history.
